name: 虛空行者護甲 Voidwalker Armor (BMT)

description.value:
護甲（鑲釘皮甲），珍稀（需同調）
這件黑色鑲釘皮甲閃着紅色的光澤。穿着這套護甲期間，你可以用一個附贈動作在距你30尺內未被佔據的空間中召喚你自己的投影。投影是你的半透明覆制體，免疫所有傷害和狀態，你可以如同自己位於投影的空間一樣發動攻擊或施放施法距離不爲自身的法術。投影在回合結束時消失。此附贈動作一經使用，直到下次黎明前不能再次使用。
詛咒Curse。這套護甲受到了詛咒，與這套受詛咒的護甲同調的生物將受到其詛咒影響。只要詛咒還在生效，你就不願意與這套護甲分開。脫下它並不能結束詛咒。以這種方式受到詛咒時，你會感到與自己的軀體與靈魂脫節，耳邊不斷聽到呼喚你加入他們的低語。每當你在被詛咒的狀態下完成一次長休時，你必須進行一次[[/save ability=cha dc=11]]豁免檢定。若豁免失敗，則你的靈魂就會從你的身體中抽出，並被困在不同存在位面的一個物件中。該物件和該物件的位置由DM選擇（也許是紙牌屋，請參閱第18章）。當你的靈魂以這種方式被困在其中時，你原本的軀體昏迷並進入靜止狀態，其不需要空氣和食物也不會衰老。摧毀物件可以釋放你的靈魂； 否則，只有 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.xjn6gjItpWpldE53]{祈願術 Wish} 才能使你的靈魂返回到你的身體裏。

This black studded leather armor bears a red sheen. While wearing this armor, you can use a bonus action to summon a projection of yourself in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. The projection is a translucent copy of you that has immunity to all damage and conditions, and you can make attacks and cast spells with a range other than self as if standing in the projection's space. The projection disappears at the end of your turn. Once you use this bonus action, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Curse. This armor is cursed, and attuning to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you're unwilling to part with the armor. Taking it off fails to end the curse. While cursed in this way, you feel disconnected from your body, continuously hearing whispers that call for you to join them. Whenever you finish a long rest while cursed, you must make a [[/save ability=cha dc=11]] saving throw. On a failed save, your soul is drawn from your body and trapped in an object on a different plane of existence. The object and location of this object are chosen by the DM (but might be the House of Cards; see chapter 18). While your soul is trapped in this way, your body is inert and doesn't age or require sustenance. Destroying the object frees your soul; otherwise, only a @spell[Wish] spell can restore your soul to your body.
